answer: An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 3 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. Because the ferrous count is verified against the mirror text itself, the kernel audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. Filling 148 aliases as a result means producing 148 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
